paragraphs: Durbin Films was founded by Md Sumon Howlader on 10 October 2021 as a home for stories set in the world our audience actually lives in: family rooms, wedding houses, the roadside tea stall, places a Bengali audience recognises before anyone speaks a line. The studio produces television dramas, web series, short films, documentaries, and brand work, and its drama has aired on television as well as online.

We work with writers, directors and actors who want the same thing, on our own productions and on commissions for channels, platforms and brands. What a client gets is simple: one person to call, a budget agreed before the shoot, and a cut you see before anyone else does.

items.a: Television dramas and telefilms, multi-episode serials and web series, short films, documentaries, music videos and brand work. The studio's own productions run on its YouTube channels and have aired on television as well.

items.q: Can you make a TVC or a brand film?
items.a: Yes. Commercials, campaign films, corporate video and launch content are made with the same crew and the same standard as the drama slate.
Send the script or the brief to the studio inbox, or message us on WhatsApp. You get back a plan, a schedule and a number, usually within two working days.

items.q: Do you take post production work on its own?
items.a: Yes. Edit, colour grade, sound design, mix and delivery are available for productions shot by somebody else.

items.q: Where can I watch the productions?
items.a: On YouTube. The studio publishes through DURBIN FILMS, DURBIN DRAMA and DURBIN, alongside the wider Durbin network of channels. Every production on this site links straight to its video.
